meta.note: Class-capability registry (Phase 1.1, PODIUM.md). Single source for the policy values that were previously mirrored across ~9 client/server sites: point caps, unlock gates, registration locks, participation rewards, ranking membership, and per-class capabilities. Presentation (labels/colors) stays in src/utils/corps.ts. This file MUST stay byte-identical to src/config/classRegistry.json — run scripts/checkClassRegistrySync.js --check (functions cannot import outside their deploy root, hence the copy).
meta.pointCapNote: pointCap is the FULL (finals-week) lineup budget; pointCapRamp is how many points below it the season opens. The budget rises 1 point per week over the season's last pointCapRamp weeks so it reaches pointCap in the final week (150 with ramp 5 over 7 weeks: 145,145,146,147,148,149,150). Both wrappers derive the schedule from these two numbers (pointCapForWeek) — never hand-mirror it.
meta.podiumNote: podiumClass is LIVE (launched July 2026): enabled here adds it to derived lists (leagues/matchups, participation rewards, registration locks); game-settings/features.podiumClass remains the runtime kill switch. hasLineup:false keeps it out of every lineup/point-cap path.
